text: Being here, I feel a quiet sense of curiosity. The crisp lines and reflective surfaces of the modern architecture invite contemplation, while the exhibit's bold colors and talk of innovation inspire an urge to inquire and understand. This is a place where thought and discovery are valued—where one can wander amidst ideas, allowing the mind to stretch and play in the spaces between technology and human connection. I feel alert, thoughtful, and just a touch exhilarated by the promise of research and development in the air.
